mods.name: C Demo Mod
mods.description: A simple native C mod demonstrating the Ugaris Client mod API. Shows basic commands, rendering, and game data access.

mods.name: C++ Demo Mod
mods.description: A native mod written in modern C++ (C++17) demonstrating the Ugaris Client mod API with classes, RAII, and type safety.

mods.name: Rust Demo Mod
mods.description: A native mod written in Rust demonstrating the Ugaris Client mod API with memory safety and zero-cost abstractions.

mods.name: Zig Demo Mod
mods.description: A native mod written in Zig demonstrating the Ugaris Client mod API with Zig's safety, performance, and excellent cross-compilation.
